'''Koloch''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] stationed on [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Koloch assisted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] personnel in the downing of the [[Three Families]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] dissidents based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of his [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|military]] administration's control.
